What can QC photos prove?

Warehouse photos are a checkpoint after an item arrives, not a certificate of quality. Compare them with the option you selected and the original listing: visible colour, label, quantity, obvious damage and supplied parts are useful checks.

When should I consider a return?

PikoBuy’s published returns policy describes a five-day application window after an eligible item enters the warehouse. Eligibility depends on the seller’s return guarantee, the condition required for resale and the item type; it is not automatic.

When does tracking appear?

Its public guide says tracking information is normally available within three days after a parcel is shipped. Save the parcel date and route before drawing conclusions from a quiet tracking page, then use the platform’s support channel with the relevant order details if the platform’s stated window has passed.

Does this guide promise shipping times or customs outcomes?

This page explains a research workflow, not a buying recommendation. Product availability, seller performance, service terms, shipping options and border outcomes can change; consult the platform’s current information for a live order.
